title: NCAA Nationals & NXR Weekend
blurb: The D-I and D-III national championships and all eight D-II regionals on Saturday, plus five Nike Cross Regionals and the Florida and Massachusetts state meets, with live results and streams in one place.
seo: NCAA Cross Country Championships & NXR Live Results & Streams
desc: Live results and streams for the 2026 NCAA Division I cross country championships in Terre Haute and Division III championships in Northfield (Nov. 21), the eight NCAA Division II regionals, Nike Cross Regionals Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, South and Southeast, and the Florida and Massachusetts state meets.

meets.name: NCAA Division I Cross Country Championships
meets.where: Terre Haute, IN · LaVern Gibson Championship Course
meets.time: Women 6K 10:20 a.m. ET · Men 10K 11:10 a.m. ET
meets.why: The national championship. Men: unanimous No. 1 New Mexico, No. 2 Colorado, defending champion No. 3 Oklahoma State and No. 4 Alabama lead 32 teams. Women: No. 1 BYU and defending champion No. 2 NC State, with Southeast champion Hannah Gapes, lead a field with No. 3 West Virginia, No. 4 Alabama and No. 5 New Mexico.

meets.name: NCAA Division III Cross Country Championships
meets.where: Northfield, MN · host Carleton · Bill Huyck Championship Course
meets.time: Women 6K 1:00 p.m. ET · Men 8K 2:00 p.m. ET
meets.why: The D-III national championship. Men: No. 1 Wartburg and No. 2 North Central (Ill.), which beat Wartburg at the Midwest Regional, lead 32 teams with No. 3 Johns Hopkins. Women: unanimous No. 1 NYU goes for back-to-back titles against No. 2 Williams, No. 3 Middlebury and No. 4 UW-La Crosse, with host Carleton in the field.
